title: ANEB unified measurement result v1
description: Self-contained result envelope for the three production simulation categories. Exporters serialize engine-persisted values and references; they must not recompute metrics, scores, confidence, conclusions, or Profile fingerprints.

digest.description: A captured digest plus its exact versioned byte/canonicalization contract. Exporters copy this object from the execution record and do not calculate it after the run.

completeness.description: Machine-readable disclosure of source fields that were not captured. A null placeholder is never treated as a measured or reconstructed value.

result_semantics.description: Machine-enforced export rules. A conforming exporter is a lossless serializer, not another scoring implementation.

status.description: Run lifecycle/terminal state. This is deliberately separate from evaluation.score.verdict.

source_record_version.description: Version of the durable source record, for example Room schema v18.

radio_context.description: Public Android radio observations only. Location coordinates are intentionally outside this shareable result contract.

collection_status.description: Explicit collection state. Empty samples with any state other than collected must never be interpreted as good radio quality.

components.description: Persisted component values emitted by the scorer, such as recovery counts or directional P05 goodput. This is not reconstructed during export.

quality_target.description: Frozen target snapshot from the resolved Profile. It is joined by identity/fingerprint, not inferred from the observed value.
